newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: Lithuanian refinery to restart Saturday.
newsitem.headline: Lithuanian refinery to restart Saturday.

text.p: Lithuania's Mazheikiu Nafta oil refinery will resume production on Saturday after a two-week halt due to a lack of crude from Russia, company officials said on Friday.
"The company intends to restart work in the second half of the day on Saturday," a spokeswoman for the company, Virginija Kristinaitiene, told Reuters.
Mazheikiu suffers from persistent problems with supply of crude oil from its sole source, Russia.
"We have 49,100 tons of crude in our reservoirs already and another 43,200 tons will be received in the near future," the spokeswoman added.
When operating normally, the company refines 13,500 tons of crude per day and most of its product is used in Lithuania.
